questions.prompt: What is said about the cod end Hoskadale tows?

options.text: He judged the larger meshes on the catch from a single trip.
Once the meshes were turned, the plaice no longer got out, a flat fish being the wrong shape for a square.
The way the netting hung was the first thing he changed in the bag.
Towing narrowed the meshes, so the extra size did not give a round fish its width.
